text:
Joel Farabee has 16 points in 17 games, six goals, and a power-play goal against Anaheim on November 6. According to a Daily Hive report, he hopes to be a Flame for the long haul, and on this evidence Calgary should be glad to hear it: almost two years after the trade from Philadelphia, he is playing 19 minutes a night in the top six of a team that has won six of its last ten.

How much of it holds? His finishing is fair (six goals on 5.81 expected), so the goals look real. The assists are softer: the Flames have scored 4.9 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, and his scoring rate of 2.98 points per 60 sits well above our range for him (about 2.0). Our season projection lands near 58 points.

His game is speed. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 61 percent of his shots coming off the rush last season, so he is at his best in the first seconds after a turnover. Evolving-Hockey also had him drawing more penalties than he takes. Watch the rush chances; that is where his season lives.
headline: Farabee has found a home in Calgary
